subject: CAudioEngine streaming and sound system — buffer layout, stream banks, and 3D audio
overview: GTA:SA's audio engine is divided into two layers: CAEAudioEnvironment (the lower-level DirectSound/Miles Sound System wrapper) and the higher-level managers (CAEVehicleAudioManager, CAEPedAudioEntity, CAEWeaponAudioEntity etc.). All streaming audio is packed in SFX.IMG and STREAMS/*.ogg streams. Sound effects are referenced by bank slot and sound ID within that bank.

sfx_bank_layout.description: SFX.IMG contains packed sound banks. Each bank is referenced by a 16-bit bank ID. At load time, CAEBankLoader maps each bank into a circular sound buffer (AUDIO_MEMORY_SIZE = 4MB). The loaded-bank table holds 155 entries.

CAESoundRequest_layout.description: When gameplay code requests a sound, it fills a CAESoundRequest struct and posts it to the request queue. The audio thread drains this queue and starts DirectSound buffer playback.

fields.name: m_pEntity
fields.description: CAEAudioEntity* that owns this request; null for UI sounds

radio_stream_layout.description: Radio streams are separate from SFX. Each station has a pre-encoded stream in AUDIO\STREAMS. The radio player uses a dedicated DirectSound buffer with a 128KB streaming ring.

stations.note: Reads MP3/OGG/WAV from My Documents\GTA San Andreas User Files\User Tracks

min_distance.description: Sound at full volume within this radius

audio_entity_hierarchy.description: All game objects that produce sound extend CAEAudioEntity. The hierarchy layers game-specific behaviour on top of the base entity.
hierarchy: CAEAudioEntity (base, owns a sound channel slot)
└─ CAEVehicleAudioEntity (engine RPM curve, horn, crash, doors)

CAERadioTrackManager_SetCurrentStation.description: Switches to a new radio station; fades out current stream

CAEBankLoader_LoadBankSlot.description: Loads a sound bank from SFX.IMG into the audio memory pool

CAEBankLoader_FreeBankSlot.description: Releases a loaded bank slot back to the pool
